observations.behavior: Adds documentation explaining the writer attribution and parity checks.
observations.code_quote: Verifier fixes on the flags cache carry a `writer` label (`posthog_hypercache_verify_fixes_total{cache_type="flags", writer="rust"|"python"|"unknown"}`), attributed by evaluating the same routing flag (`get_team_primary_flags_writer` in `flags_cache.py`): a fix on a rust-routed team is the parity signal that the Rust builder diverged, which the unattributed counter blends into Python's baseline repair noise. `unknown` means the routing flag couldn't be evaluated at fix time, so an attribution outage can't masquerade as a clean Rust ramp.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation of the hypercache verifier and its relationship to the Rust/Python dual-writer setup.
